title: Turkish Narrative Past Tense (-miş)
summary: Expressing hearsay, indirect, or unexpected past events.
explanation: Attach '-miş/-mış/-muş/-müş' to the verb stem followed by personal suffixes for reported or inferred past actions.

example_translations.ex_trmish_1: You have reportedly read this book (or I noticed you did).

common_error_explanations.err_trmish_1: Use '-miş' for hearsay or newly discovered past facts.
